measurement: The deployed system, verified over the public internet

hosting.api: Render, service counsel-api, free plan, Singapore
hosting.storage: SQLite at /tmp/counsel-ephemeral.db — EPHEMERAL, lost on restart
hosting.public: Vercel Authentication disabled so the URL opens without a login

cold_start.why: The instance was warm throughout this measurement round. Render's free plan spins a service down after 15 minutes idle; the first request after that wakes it and is slow. Recording the vendor behaviour rather than a number this run did not observe.
cold_start.observed_qualitatively: The first request after the initial deploy took roughly a minute.

asserts: the crew capability table is populated by the live API and every row reads side effects: none
the untrusted-content scanner runs live and clears a legitimate policy document
the 3D chamber renders and is handed five DISTINCT hex seat colours, not the grey fallback

embedder.why: The 384-dim MiniLM ONNX model does not fit Render's 512 MB free instance — the process was killed and the request 502'd in 13s. COUNSEL_DISABLE_FASTEMBED=1 makes no-embedder a supported state rather than a crash.
embedder.consequence: Search on the deployed instance is LEXICAL ONLY. The cross-lingual retrieval result in A7-fusion-crosslingual.json does not hold on this instance.
embedder.recovery: Set GEMINI_API_KEY on the Render service; the embedder chain then resolves to gemini-embedding-001 (768-dim).

inference.why: No GEMINI_API_KEY or GROQ_API_KEY is set. Keys were deliberately not handled during deployment.
inference.consequence: Debate turns are deterministic stub output derived from a sha256 of the input, not model output.
inference.recovery: Set GEMINI_API_KEY and GROQ_API_KEY on the Render service.

sqlite_vec.why: Render's Python is built without --enable-loadable-sqlite-extensions, so conn.enable_load_extension does not exist and sqlite-vec can never load. Found by deploying — every local Python has the flag, so the suite was green and the first live request was a 500.
sqlite_vec.consequence: None to correctness. Vector search falls back to a brute-force cosine scan in numpy; a test asserts the two produce identical ranking.
sqlite_vec.recovery: Not needed at this corpus size.

storage.why: The free plan has no persistent disk.
storage.consequence: Uploaded documents and transcripts are lost when the instance restarts.
storage.recovery: A Render disk, which is a paid plan.

health_payload_is_honest.claim: The deployed /healthz names every degradation rather than reporting OK.
health_payload_is_honest.embedder_note: No embedding model fits this environment. Search is lexical only and cannot match across languages. Set GEMINI_API_KEY to restore it.
